🎬 Your Heart will be Broken 2026

Твоё сердце будет разбито / Your Heart Will Be Broken (2026)
A Russian teen romantic drama directed by Mikhail Vaynberg, based on the novel of the same name by Anna Jane — Russia's best-selling author in 2023, 2024, and 2025. The film was released theatrically in Russia on March 26, 2026, and premiered on digital platforms on May 31, 2026.
Plot Overview: The story follows Polina Tumanova, a high school student who transfers to a new school in Yekaterinburg after a traumatic incident at her previous institution. Upon arrival, she becomes the target of bullying led by Lika Malinovskaya, a popular student who turns the class against her. Polina strikes a deal with Dima Barsov, nicknamed "Bars" — a rebellious classmate known for his motorcycle, confrontations with teachers, and intimidating reputation. In exchange for his protection and a fake boyfriend arrangement, Polina agrees to help him with his studies to prevent expulsion before graduation. As the arrangement progresses, the dynamic between them shifts, though external pressures from family and classmates continue to interfere.

Reception: The film holds a rating of 6.8 on Kinoafisha (based on 374 votes) and a 4.5 on IMDb. On the Russian aggregator "Kritikanstvo," it received a score of 59/100 based on four reviews. Critical reception was mixed, with some reviewers noting the film's reliance on familiar teen romance tropes and its target demographic of teenage girls. The soundtrack notably features licensed music from the K-pop group BTS, reflecting the characters' fandom interests.

Sequel: In April 2026, it was officially announced that a sequel titled По осколкам твоего сердца (By the Shards of Your Heart) had entered production, also based on Jane's literary follow-up to the original novel.
Genre: Teen Romance / Drama
